home_tagline_start: Free widgets and APIs for your
usage_purpose_body: Personal sites. /now pages, sidebars, footers, about pages, and the like. If you're a person putting things about yourself on the internet, you're the intended audience.
usage_not_for_body: Any kind of commercial usage, bulk data collection, or mirroring our responses as your own API.
usage_rate_limits_body: The same IP can make up to 20 requests per minute. If you exceed this limit, your requests will be blocked for the next few minutes.
usage_reasonable_body_1: We already cache the services responses to avoid they rate limiting us and to provide faster responses. Please be so kind to make sure to do the same, if you're calling the API yourself, cache responses on your end as well.
usage_reasonable_body_2: We only fetch what is already made public by the third party services. Keep your links and credits pointing back at those services, and don't use this project to fetch other people's data.
usage_no_guarantees_body_1: Please beware this is a free project made by one person running on my home server. These APIs are unofficial, which means they can change or disappear without warning, and so can this project.
usage_no_guarantees_body_2_start: I'll do my best to keep it online. If anything seems broken, please
usage_contact_body: If in doubt, please ask. Send an email to Doce at "agri[myname].fer@gmail.com".
about_intro: started because I wanted to make it easy to say what you're up to without the additional work to regularly update it manually. It uses data from services you already use. Some of them either don't have a public API or require a backend to implement. So this is why this site exists!
about_how_1: On your side, you can just copy a widget script or implement our API.
about_how_2: From our end, we either talk to the service APIs or grab the data directly from their website, then we cache the response (so it loads faster for the next visitors), and hand back something easy to work with.
about_how_3_start: The entire thing is built with SvelteKit, running on
about_how_4_end: , so issues and pull requests are welcome. If something breaks, please tell me!

about_disclaimers_cache: This data may be cached for a maximum of {hours} hours, then discarded.
about_disclaimers_stats: We store anonymized and aggregated usage stats.
service_letterboxd_description: Your top 4 films, and the movies you watched recently.
service_steam_description: Playtime of your recently played games and what you're playing right now.
service_storygraph_description: Your currently reading books, recently read, to-read list, favorites, and owned.
option_user: Username to load the activity from
option_labels: Set to "false" to show only the covers
endpoint_letterboxd: Profile, watch counts, your ratings, favorite films, recent activity, and reviews.
endpoint_letterboxd_diary: Diary entries with watch dates, ratings, likes, and rewatches.
